steps.en: Add the package and load its JS plus introjs.css
steps.zh: 装上包，引入它的 JS 和 introjs.css

steps.en: Mark each element to explain with its text and order
steps.zh: 给要讲解的元素写上说明文字和顺序

steps.en: Start the tour from your page script
steps.zh: 在页面脚本里启动引导

steps.en: Collects the marked elements in order, dims the page and spotlights the first one
steps.zh: 按顺序收集标记过的元素，把页面压暗，聚光第一个

steps.en: Places a tooltip beside it, scrolls it into view, wires Next/Back, arrow keys and Esc
steps.zh: 在旁边摆好提示框，滚到可见处，接好下一步、上一步、方向键和 Esc

steps.en: Walks step by step to the last element, then removes the overlay and fires your exit callback
steps.zh: 一步步走到最后一个元素，然后撤掉遮罩，调用你的退出回调

value.en: A guided walkthrough of an existing page with no framework, no runtime deps and no backend — only attributes and one call
value.zh: 不用框架、不带运行时依赖、不要后端，只靠几个属性加一行调用，就给现有页面加上分步讲解

sources: https://github.com/usablica/intro.js#readme (Where to get: npm install intro.js --save; How to use: include intro.js + introjs.css, add data-intro and data-step)
https://github.com/usablica/intro.js/blob/master/src/index.ts (introJs() deprecated in favour of introJs.tour() / introJs.hint())
